> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `sign verify: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance sign verify (<id> | --all) [flags]
```

Recompute the content fingerprint of the entity or change request/ECO identified by id and check it against the fingerprint its stored signature records are bound to. Reports a match, content changed since signing, or a corrupt/invalid record, with signer, timestamp, meaning and provider.

`--all` sweeps every record in the ledger, optionally narrowed by `--scope` (a path to a query file or entity file). Runs entirely offline: no git history, identity provider or certificate authority needs to be reachable.

Exit codes: 0 all signatures match, 1 mismatch or invalid record, 2 tool or usage error.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | — | verify every record in the signature ledger |
| `--commit hash` | — | verify against the content at this commit hash (default: the working tree) |
| `--json` | — | emit machine-readable JSON |
| `--scope path` | — | with --all, path to a query file or entity file that limits the sweep |
